name: Rust TAOCP
postCreateCommand: rustc --version && cargo --version && claude --version && agy --version && mkdir -p ~/.codex && echo 'sandbox_mode = "danger-full-access"' > ~/.codex/config.toml && { [ -f ~/.claude.json ] || echo '{}' > ~/.claude.json; } && jq '.hasCompletedOnboarding = true' ~/.claude.json > ~/.claude.json.tmp && mv ~/.claude.json.tmp ~/.claude.json
